messages:
support_lead: FYI getting an enterprise escalation — multiple customers in eu1 seeing 5xx/timeouts to hosted inference since ~07:10 UTC. Alerts show 502/504 spike on API gateway. raising here for triage.
alyssa_sre: saw it on dashboards, error budget burning on eu1-route. latency p50 up from 40ms -> 320ms, p95 huge. beginning correlating traces. first sample request ids: req_0a3f2, req_0a3f9, req_0a3ff.
juan_net: provider side reported BGP churn earlier in the window. peering node eu1-pe-02 had flaps at 07:06-07:12 UTC. I can pull flow logs and traceroutes from affected hosts.
oncall-sre: @juan_net please paste traceroute output, and check NIC error counters on the inference frontends. Also list which customer routes are hitting eu1 vs eu2.
juan_net: attaching quick outputs:
```
# from frontend-01-eu1
traceroute to transit-gw (10.12.4.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.1.1  0.58 ms  0.52 ms  0.49 ms
 2  10.0.240.1  1.02 ms  1.03 ms  1.01 ms
 3  transit-peer-eu1 (198.51.100.17)  4.2 ms  4.1 ms  100.5 ms
 4  198.51.100.18  98.7 ms  99.1 ms  97.9 ms
```
There's intermittent 100ms jumps at hop 3->4, packet loss visible on mtr.
ops-bot: alert: eu1 API gateway 502 rate 12.7/min (threshold 5/min) — increased retries observed.
sam_reliability: confirm customer impact: enterprise_support, what are they reporting?
enterprise_support: Customer Gamma reports 15% of requests hit 5xx between 07:08-07:15 UTC. They provided a curl log and a short repro: repeated POSTs to /v1/generate with a 10s client timeout. They observed connection resets then retries. Concerned about duplicate billed tokens on retry.
alyssa_sre: looking into logs — gateway returns 502 with backend connection reset. Backend proxies show TCP retransmits and some connection reset by peer (RST) to model-runtime nodes.
nina_prod: we've got sytem metrics: packet_in_errors on some hosts in eu1 net-devs at 07:05 spike, RX drops increased on the hypervisor NICs. kernel logs show repeated "NETDEV WATCHDOG" around same time.
juan_net: provider confirmed they had microbursts on the PE facing our fabric due to an upstream neighbor flapping -> causing transient packet loss and BGP withdraw/announce chatter. They claim stabilization at 07:20 UTC but we still see elevated retries.
oncall-sre: mitigation options? can we shift traffic to eu2 for affected prefixes or enable fast-failover?
sam_reliability: we can temporarily route control-plane traffic away from eu1 to eu2 using smart routing policy for customer-tier:standard. That needs config change in routing config with gradual shift to avoid spike. Also consider increasing gateway connect timeouts from 5s -> 10s as temporary safety.
alyssa_sre: quick reproduction steps (for support to confirm):
1) set region=eu1 in request headers
2) run 50 concurrent requests of the short prompt (approx 40 tokens) with client timeout 8s and no retries.
3) observe 502s / connection reset.
Example curl (one-off):
```
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'X-Region: eu1' -d '{"prompt":"test"}' &
done
wait
```
We should tell customers to set region=eu2 as workaround.
enterprise_support: Customer Gamma will accept routing to eu2 but asks about data residency — need note for compliance. Also asks whether retries caused double billing. They have idempotency-key usage for most calls but some pre-existing clients don't set it.
sam_reliability: billing note: retries that result in distinct successful completions could bill twice. We should offer Gamma credits if they were hit and couldn't use idempotency. I'll open a billing review.
oncall-sre: production action items: (1) route small percentage of traffic to eu2 (2) increase gateway connect timeout to 10s and reduce aggressive client retries (3) open ticket with transit provider and request root cause timeline (4) schedule infra NIC health sweep on eu1 hypervisors. Assign owners.
alyssa_sre: I'm taking (2) and will push a config tweak to gateway (will canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green). Deploy plan:
- 07:40 apply connect_timeout=10s on gateway pool eu1 (canary 5%)
- monitor error rate for 10m, if decreases escalate canary to 25%
- rollback if backend errors increase or latency regresses.
deploy-bot: @alyssa_sre triggered gateway-config update (change-id=cg-20260315-1) canary: 5% applied to gw-eu1-pool-03.
alyssa_sre: initial canary shows 502s down from 12.7/min -> 6.1/min in the small shard after 4m. p95 latency still elevated but improving.
juan_net: started flow capture on peering interface. Quick sample shows ~0.8% packet loss in 20s window during earlier spike with retransmits causing backend timeouts.
oncall-sre: good. let's also enable our fallback policy to auto-route to eu2 when gw failure rate > 3% for 3 minutes for standard customers. Sam, can you own the rollout?
sam_reliability: will take it. implementing rule in smart-router: fallback_threshold=3%, window=3m, weight-shift=30%/min. Planning to activate at 08:00 after validating provider ticket progress.
enterprise_support: Customer Gamma: will you document the workaround (region switch) and confirm we'll give a service credit if they saw duplicate billing?
support_lead: yes. I'll send formal message and offer credit. Also ask Gamma to confirm which calls had no idempotency.
oncall-sre: long term: schedule cross-team postmortem with network, infra, and product to consider automatic region failover for enterprise tenants and improved billing safeguards (idempotency enforcement and retry dedupe).
alyssa_sre: final note: current status 08:11 UTC: gateway errors trending down in canary shard, provider reports stabilized at 07:20 but we see residual packet loss on peering link. continuing to monitor, will update when eu1 pool clear. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: incident update posted to #incidents-archive (incident_id: INC-20260315-09, severity: high, start: 2498765432, current_status: mitigated-canary).
support_lead: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer comms and credits.
enterprise_support: Gamma acknowledged workaround and awaiting credit confirmation.
oncall-sre: closing actionable items summary: owner mapping: routing -> sam_reliability, gateway-config -> alyssa_sre, provider ticket -> juan_net, NIC sweep -> nina_prod, billing review -> support_lead. follow-up postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-16.
